0022600100.text: Both the Pelicans and the Jazz are 0-1, with New Orleans sitting 8th in the West and 1 game back in the Southwest, and Utah 12th in the West and 1.5 games back in the Northwest. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but New Orleans won all three of their 2025-26 meetings, most recently 156-137 in New Orleans on April 7. Utah will be without Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot strain) and Trey Alexander (out, knee bruise).
